name: s_fixedKeyCodes
meaning: Holds the client key code of each Carbon keycode, -1 where the layout fills it

name: s_editCommandKeys
meaning: Holds the five Edit menu command IDs, each with the key code of its letter

name: s_chordPrefixes
meaning: Holds the modifier codes 0 to 2 with their chord prefixes SHIFT-, CTRL- and ALT-

name: s_textInputActive
meaning: Holds whether text input is active; mac:03337e stores it and mac:0334bc clears it

name: s_carbonHandler
meaning: Holds the event handler UPP made from mac:089e3e

name: s_inputRing
meaning: Holds the input ring's 32 five-dword records

name: s_inputRingRead
meaning: Holds the ring index of the oldest input record

name: s_inputRingWrite
meaning: Holds the ring index the next input record is written at

name: s_carbonModifiers
meaning: Holds the Carbon modifier word of the last modifiers-changed event

name: s_keyCodes
meaning: Holds the live key code of each Carbon keycode, the fixed table filled from the layout

name: s_keyLayout
meaning: Holds the KCHR the live key codes were filled from, null at load

name: s_modifierKeys
meaning: Holds the held modifier bits, 1 << code for SHIFT, CTRL and ALT
